title: nf-core/gwas pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input. One row is one analysis unit: a single cohort paired with a single trait.

analysis_id.description: Unique identifier for this analysis unit. Used as the focal identifier in every output path and filename.
analysis_id.errorMessage: Analysis ID must be provided, must be unique across the samplesheet and cannot contain spaces

cohort_id.description: Identifier of the cohort these genotypes belong to. Rows sharing a cohort ID must declare the same genotype source.
cohort_id.errorMessage: Cohort ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

trait_id.description: Identifier of the trait under analysis. Several traits may share one cohort ID.
trait_id.errorMessage: Trait ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

trait_type.description: Declared type of the trait. Never inferred from the phenotype values or from prevalence.
trait_type.errorMessage: Trait type must be one of 'quantitative' or 'binary'

genome_build.description: Genome build the genotypes are on. Build-keyed reference resources are selected from this value; aliases are rejected.
genome_build.errorMessage: Genome build must be one of 'GRCh37' or 'GRCh38'

ancestry.description: Case-sensitive ancestry label carried through to output provenance.
ancestry.errorMessage: Ancestry must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, underscores, dots and dashes

pgen.description: PLINK 2 genotype file. Supply together with 'psam' and 'pvar', and leave the other two genotype groups empty.
pgen.errorMessage: PLINK 2 genotype file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.pgen'

psam.errorMessage: PLINK 2 sample file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.psam'

pvar.errorMessage: PLINK 2 variant file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.pvar' or '.pvar.zst'

bed.description: PLINK 1 genotype file. Supply together with 'bim' and 'fam', and leave the other two genotype groups empty.
bed.errorMessage: PLINK 1 genotype file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.bed'

bim.errorMessage: PLINK 1 variant file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.bim'

fam.errorMessage: PLINK 1 sample file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.fam'

vcf.description: VCF genotype file, converted once per cohort to PLINK 2. Leave the two PLINK genotype groups empty when this is supplied.
vcf.errorMessage: VCF file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.vcf', '.vcf.gz' or '.vcf.bgz'

vcf_index.description: Optional index for 'vcf'. Declared for completeness; the VCF converter does not consume it, so it is not required to complete the VCF genotype group.
vcf_index.errorMessage: VCF index cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.tbi' or '.csi'

phenotype.description: Headered phenotype file containing the trait column named by 'phenotype_column'.
phenotype.errorMessage: Phenotype file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must exist

phenotype_column.description: Name of the column in 'phenotype' holding this trait. Always named explicitly, even when the file has a single trait column.
phenotype_column.errorMessage: Phenotype column must be provided and cannot contain spaces

control_value.description: Value used for controls in 'phenotype'. Carried as a string, so numeric conventions such as PLINK's 1 and textual ones such as 'Control' are both accepted. Required on binary rows, rejected on quantitative rows.
control_value.errorMessage: Control value must be a single token without spaces, for example '1' or 'Control'

case_value.description: Value used for cases in 'phenotype'. Carried as a string, so numeric conventions such as PLINK's 2 and textual ones such as 'Case' are both accepted. Required on binary rows, rejected on quantitative rows.
case_value.errorMessage: Case value must be a single token without spaces, for example '2' or 'Case'

quant_covariates.description: Optional headered file of prepared quantitative covariates.
quant_covariates.errorMessage: Quantitative covariate file cannot contain spaces and must exist

cat_covariates.description: Optional headered file of prepared categorical covariates.
cat_covariates.errorMessage: Categorical covariate file cannot contain spaces and must exist

association_methods.description: Comma-delimited association methods to run: 'plink2', 'regenie', 'gcta_fastgwa', 'ldak_kvik'. There is no inherited run-wide default set.
association_methods.errorMessage: Association methods must be a comma-delimited list of lowercase tokens with no spaces

heritability_methods.description: Comma-delimited heritability methods to run: 'gcta_greml', 'gcta_greml_ldms', 'ldak_reml', 'ldak_he', 'ldak_pcgc'. There is no inherited run-wide default set.
heritability_methods.errorMessage: Heritability methods must be a comma-delimited list of lowercase tokens with no spaces

population_prevalence.description: Population prevalence of a binary trait, used to report heritability on the liability scale. Always required by LDAK PCGC.
population_prevalence.errorMessage: Population prevalence must be a number strictly between 0 and 1

sample_prevalence.description: Case proportion in the analysed sample. Only meaningful alongside a population prevalence, to correct ascertainment on the liability scale.
sample_prevalence.errorMessage: Sample prevalence must be a number strictly between 0 and 1

ldak_model.description: Kinship model used by the LDAK heritability routes. 'human_default' is the documented human model and fixes 'ldak_power' at -0.25; 'custom' hands the power to the researcher.
ldak_model.errorMessage: LDAK model must be one of 'human_default' or 'custom'

ldak_power.description: Power applied to predictor variances when LDAK builds its kinship matrix. The default is the documented human model value and is reported explicitly rather than left implicit.
ldak_power.errorMessage: LDAK power must be a number between -2 and 0

ldak_weights.description: Optional LDAK predictor weights file used when building kinship matrices. Leave empty to use explicit equal weights.
ldak_weights.errorMessage: LDAK weights file cannot contain spaces and must exist

ldak_relatedness_filter.description: Restrict this analysis's LDAK heritability estimator to an unrelated subset. Carried at the estimator, so the kinship matrix shared with unrestricted analyses is unchanged.
ldak_relatedness_filter.errorMessage: LDAK relatedness filter must be 'true' or 'false'

ldak_kvik_step1_subset.description: How LDAK-KVIK selects its step 1 predictor subset: every predictor, a thinned common set, or the list in 'ldak_kvik_step1_extract'. Required with 'ldak_kvik' and resolved explicitly rather than by default.
ldak_kvik_step1_subset.errorMessage: KVIK step 1 subset must be one of 'all', 'thin_common' or 'provided'

ldak_kvik_step1_extract.description: Predictor list used for LDAK-KVIK step 1. Accepted only when 'ldak_kvik_step1_subset' is 'provided'.
ldak_kvik_step1_extract.errorMessage: KVIK step 1 extract file cannot contain spaces and must exist

gcta_grm_parts.description: Number of parts GCTA splits its relatedness matrix build into. A memory control rather than a scientific setting, required with any GCTA route and stated explicitly rather than defaulted.
gcta_grm_parts.errorMessage: GCTA relatedness matrix part count must be an integer of 1 or more

gcta_sparse_cutoff.description: Relatedness cutoff used to derive the sparse GCTA matrix for fastGWA-MLM. The default follows the official fastGWA example.
gcta_sparse_cutoff.errorMessage: GCTA sparse relatedness cutoff must be a number between 0 and 1

gcta_ld_score_region_kb.description: Region width in kilobases used to calculate GCTA LD scores for GREML-LDMS. The default follows the official LDMS example.
gcta_ld_score_region_kb.errorMessage: GCTA LD-score region width must be an integer of 1 kilobase or more

gcta_ld_bins.description: Number of individual-SNP LD-score strata used by GCTA GREML-LDMS. The default divides the scores into quartiles.
gcta_ld_bins.errorMessage: GCTA LD bin count must be an integer of 1 or more

gcta_ldms_maf_edges.description: Semicolon-delimited, strictly ordered minor allele frequency interval boundaries for GCTA GREML-LDMS. The boundaries must start at 0 and end at 0.5 so every valid predictor belongs to exactly one stratum. Semicolons are used because commas already delimit the method selector lists.
gcta_ldms_maf_edges.errorMessage: MAF boundaries must be a semicolon-delimited list of numbers spanning 0 to 0.5, for example '0;0.01;0.05;0.2;0.5'
